anchor_statement: atm-bd must show a sanity runs page and a quality runs page, newest run on top, one line per run; the sanity line must carry a pass/fail column and an elapsed-time column for JEV and for LLM each, and a column with the name and nerd icon of the dev whose work was checked; elapsed comes from the Jev client's own return and from a timer fenced around the LLM subagent, and the same rows feed the OTel database in the next atm release.

atm-bd adds a sanity runs page and a quality runs page, newest run first, one row per run. A sanity row shows JEV pass/fail and elapsed, LLM pass/fail and elapsed, and the checked dev's name with its nerd icon; JEV elapsed is what the Jev client returns, LLM elapsed is a timer around the LLM subagent, and the same rows feed the OTel database in the next atm release.
